rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a textbook or coursebook.

example.english: This textbook is pretty easy to understand.
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 fo3 bun2 gei2 ji6 ming4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this more formal term when referring specifically to an official school-subject textbook.

example.english: The school adopted a new textbook this year.
example.traditional: 學校今年採用新嘅教科書。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 gam1 nin4 coi2 jung6 san1 ge3 gaau3 fo1 syu1
